_provenance.state_action_map: per-joint linear fit action_t vs state_(t+3) over the 168-episode corpus; arm joints r>=0.998 (|res| med<1 deg), gripper r=0.897. Elbow/wrist_flex/wrist_yaw sign-flipped; gripper 0..269 state -> 0..~47 action
_provenance.rate_limits: same per-tick envelope as eval_session.sh B601_MAX_ACTION_DELTA (demonstrated p99.9 + ~30%)
_provenance.move_step: half the rate limit: staged moves are OURS and have no reason to ride the safety envelope
_provenance.divergence: healthy eval trials <=5 deg sustained (30-tick rolling min), grasp-contact 7, C2 table press 11 -> threshold 15 held 1 s aborts; guard compares command vs CONVERTED state so healthy baseline is the fit residual
_provenance.poses: corpus medians: park over first 8 frames (p90 spread <=4.7 deg arm), verify at mid-hold (arm raised, held block in wrist view), place 5 frames before release-open onset (p90 spread <=7.7 pan)
_provenance.saucer: success = red fraction inside the 30 px disk at (464,315) >= 0.20; placed blocks read 0.30-0.63 (p5 0.302 healthy), trial starts 0.000; LOCAL check because skin passes the red gate (ep24's hand)
_provenance.verify: burst majority 3/5 at the verify pose ONLY (low-hover blind spot, eval eps 21/29)
